basic_details.short_information: Office of the District Programme Officer, Hapur has released the Hapur Anganwadi Karyakartri & Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Notification on 28 July 2026 on the official website https://upanganwadibharti.in. or merit list criteria). It does clarify the residency-based preference rule (gram sabha
then Nyaya Panchayat) described above. Candidates are advised to thoroughly study the full Government Order dated 17.09.2025 for the complete selection procedure

how_to_apply: Carefully read the detailed Government Order dated 17 September 2025 before applying.
Locate and fill the online application form for Anganwadi Karyakartri or Anganwadi Sahayika, as applicable.
Enter the required personal, educational, and residential (gram sabha) details.
Submit the online application before the last date, i.e., 18 August 2026, till midnight 12:00.

Important: Only online applications submitted through upanganwadibharti.in within the prescribed period will be accepted. Offline applications or any other documents will not be considered valid under any circumstances, as per the official notice.

For further information, candidates can contact the Child Development Project Office at the block level or the District Programme Officer (Child Development) office at Vikas Bhawan during working hours.

content_sections.heading: Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Programme Officer, Hapur has officially released the Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification vide Notification Letter No. C-541 / District Programme Office / Anganwadi Appointment / 2026-27 dated 28 July 2026 for the recruitment of 317 Anganwadi Karyakartri and Anganwadi Sahayika posts in the rural Child Development Projects of Hapur district. The notification contains complete information regarding project-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limit, educational qualifications, residency requirements, application process, and important instructions. Candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully before submitting the online application. The notification is available on the official Anganwadi recruitment portal. content_sections.heading: Hapur Anganwadi Karyakartri Sahayika Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
content_sections.text: Government Order Date: 17 September 2025 Notification (Vigyapti) Date: 28 July 2026 Online Application Start Date: Not specified in the official notice; candidates should check upanganwadibharti.in for the exact start date. Last Date to Apply Online: 18 August 2026 (till midnight 12:00) Age Reckoning / Cut-off Date: 1 July 2026

content_sections.heading: Hapur Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 Details (Project-wise)
content_sections.text: The notification specifies vacancies separately for Anganwadi Karyakartri and Anganwadi Sahayika posts across four rural Child Development Projects: Garhmukteshwar, Simbhawali, Dhaulana, and Hapur. Note: The official notice states that no vacancies are reserved under the ST (Scheduled Tribe) category for any project in this recruitment cycle. Complete gram sabha-wise vacancy and reservation details are available at the Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, Tehsil, District Programme Office (Child Development), and Block Development Office notice boards, as well as on upanganwadibharti.in.

content_sections.heading: Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for the advertised posts. The candidate must be a permanent resident of the gram sabha to which the vacant post belongs. If an eligible candidate from the required category is not available in that gram sabha, a candidate who is a permanent resident of the concerned Nyaya Panchayat is eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Karyakartri Sahayika Educational Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Anganwadi Karyakartri: Minimum qualification - Intermediate (12th) or its equivalent; Maximum qualification - Postgraduate. Anganwadi Sahayika: Educational qualification for the Sahayika post is not specified in the official notice. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed Government Order dated 17.09.2025 for this information.

content_sections.heading: Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 35 years Cut-off Date for Age Calculation: 1 July 2026 Information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories is not available in the official notice.

content_sections.heading: Hapur Anganwadi Karyakartri Sahayika Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The posts are described as honorarium-based (मानदेय) in the official notification; however, the exact monthly honorarium amount for Anganwadi Karyakartri and Sahayika posts is not available in this notice. Candidates should refer to the Government Order dated 17.09.2025 or the official website upanganwadibharti.in for honorarium details.

content_sections.heading: Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Application fee details are not mentioned in the official notification. Candidates should check the online application portal upanganwadibharti.in at the time of filling the form for fee-related information, if applicable.

content_sections.heading: Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official notice does not specify a detailed step-by-step selection process (such as written exam, interview, or merit list criteria). It does clarify the residency-based preference rule (gram sabha, then Nyaya Panchayat) described above. Candidates are advised to thoroughly study the full Government Order dated 17.09.2025 for the complete selection procedure, as the notice states that the entire recruitment process will be conducted on the basis of that order.

content_sections.heading: Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: A specific list of documents required for the application is not available in this notice. The detailed application proforma and requirements are stated to be available on the official website upanganwadibharti.in and at Child Development Project offices, Block Development Officer offices, and Vikas Bhawan, Hapur.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Hapur Anganwadi Karyakartri Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: upanganwadibharti.in Carefully read the detailed Government Order dated 17 September 2025 before applying. Locate and fill the online application form for Anganwadi Karyakartri or Anganwadi Sahayika, as applicable. Enter the required personal, educational, and residential (gram sabha) details. Submit the online application before the last date, i.e., 18 August 2026, till midnight 12:00. Important: Only online applications submitted through upanganwadibharti.in within the prescribed period will be accepted. Offline applications or any other documents will not be considered valid under any circumstances, as per the official notice.

content_sections.heading: Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates mustfe thoroughly study Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17.09.2025 before applying, as the entire recruitment process will be based on this order. Only female candidates are eligible for these posts. Gram sabha-wise vacancy and reservation details, along with full eligibility conditions, are displayed on notice boards at the Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, Tehsil offices, District Programme Office (Child Development), and Block Development Offices in Hapur district. For further information, candidates can contact the Child Development Project Office at the block level or the District Programme Officer (Child Development) office at Vikas Bhawan during working hours.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are there in Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 317 vacancies — 120 for Anganwadi Karyakartri and 197 for Anganwadi Sahayika — across four rural projects: Garhmukteshwar, Simbhawali, Dhaulana, and Hapur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 18 August 2026, till midnight 12:00.

faq.question: Q3. Can male candidates apply for Anganwadi Karyakartri or Sahayika posts?
faq.answer: No. As per the official notice, only female candidates are eligible for these posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Hapur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years and not more than 35 years of age as on the cut-off date, 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for Anganwadi Karyakartri post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th) or its equivalent, and the maximum qualification allowed is Postgraduate.

faq.question: Q6. Is residency in the gram sabha mandatory for applying?
faq.answer: Yes. The candidate must be a permanent resident of the gram sabha where the vacant post is located. If no eligible candidate is available there, a permanent resident of the concerned Nyaya Panchayat may apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or honorarium for these posts?
faq.answer: The exact honorarium amount is not mentioned in this notice. These are honorarium-based posts, and candidates should refer to the official Government Order for further details.
